pages.text: Ah. A customer. &6Cassius Vellum&r, Skyhaven Bank. Every coin counted twice. And you are {player}. Noted.
The arrangement is simple. Your &6purse&r is what you carry. Your &6bank&r is what you keep here. Deposit and withdraw whenever you like, free of charge.
And the part I enjoy: on your &6first login each day&r I pay &6interest&r into your account. One per cent of your savings, up to five thousand coins. Money should sleep, and wake up richer.
Selling is easy. Shopkeepers buy goods at fair prices, &6/sell&r does the same from anywhere in the hub, and &6/pay&r sends coins to a friend. Here is a little to start the ledger.

choices.label: Thank you. I'll look in on my account.
